title.narrative: Strengthening WASH Services and Cholera Prevention for Vulnerable Populations in Dikwa and Gwoza

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtTaimako Community Development Initiative (TCDI), in partnership with Care First Community Initiative (CFCI) and Yong Prodigy Humanitarian Organization (YPHO), proposes a 6-month WASH intervention to enhance nutrition, safety, and protection for vulnerable women and children in Dikwa and Gwoza. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThis project will target 5,000 people (3,000 IDPs and 2,000 host community members, including 1,200 persons with disabilities) with life-saving WASH services. Activities include the construction of 5 new boreholes and rehabilitation of 6 non-functional ones, operation and maintenance of 20 solar-powered boreholes, and water quality testing in 20 facilities. lt/pgtltpgtSanitation will be improved through the construction of 4 gender-segregated, disability-friendly latrine blocks, desludging of 50 latrines.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtTo address cholera and AWD risks, TCDI and partners, will deliver community hygiene promotion, IEC materials, and the formation of peer groups. Special focus will be placed on menstrual hygiene management (MHM), protection risk reduction (lighting at water points, dignity kits), and the removal of barriers to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtAligned with the WASH Cluster Strategic Response Plan, the project will contribute to improved access to safe water, dignified sanitation, and sustained hygiene practices, thereby reducing cholera, AWD, and malnutrition among the most vulnerable populations.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtTCDI will implement the water and sanitation components in Dikwa, while CFCI will in Gwoza. YPHO will implement the hygiene promotion component in both LGAs. TCDI, as lead partner, will oversee capacity building of both organizations through mentoring, joint planning, technical supervision, and regular coaching to ensure quality implementation and compliance with WASH Cluster standards.ltbrgtlt/pgt
